definition: ROI = tight bounding box of the FROZEN MODEL'S OWN thresholded prediction, expanded by the same frozen 1.5x rule

empty_case_structure.note: a NO_PREDICTED_ROI arises when the global prediction is empty. On this VAL population that coincides exactly with a total miss, so the deployable path fails precisely where recovery is most needed.

interpretation_guard: this is a diagnostic of what a TRIVIAL, UNTRAINED prediction-derived ROI achieves. It is not a benefit predictor, not a router, and not a proposed method. Any stronger claim would require training, which Phase 22 forbids.
